event_venue_information:
About VOO Lounge

VOO Lounge is a sophisticated jazz venue located in downtown Kansas City in the historic Kansas City Marriott Downtown building. The space features elegant art-deco decor and intimate lounge seating with live jazz performances.

Historic Significance

The venue occupies the same building where the Coon-Sanders Original Nighthawk Orchestra once made jazz history with late-night national radio broadcasts establishing Kansas Citys jazz legacy.

Regular Events

Open mic jazz jam every Wednesday from 7-11 PM with no cover charge and free downtown parking. Friday and Saturday feature rotating jazz musicians and performers. The venue also hosts cocktail making classes and special events.

Atmosphere

Speakeasy-style ambiance with dim lighting plush seating and a fully stocked bar featuring craft cocktails. Wednesday night specials include 25% off for musicians and service industry professionals.

title: Free Open Jam @ Knuckleheads
event_description: Weekly open jam sessions featuring a mix of zydeco blues oldies classic rock and country. Musicians can sign up to perform or enjoy the performances with $1 tacos and beer.
backline: Microphones and sound system provided - bring your own mic if preferred
event_venue_information:
About Knuckleheads

Knuckleheads is one of Kansas Citys premier music venues featuring multiple stages including an indoor stage and outdoor garage space. The venue has a capacity of 600 and hosts national touring acts as well as local musicians.

Open Jam Sessions

Free Saturday afternoon sessions from 12:30-6 PM and Sunday sessions from 1 PM. All skill levels welcome. Musicians can bring their own microphones or use sanitized house equipment. 21+ venue but minors allowed with parent or guardian.

Regular Programming

Live music Wednesday through Monday with shows typically starting at 7:30-8 PM. The venue features blues rock country Americana and diverse genres. Special events include open mic storytelling competitions and themed tribute nights.

Amenities

Full bar service with reasonably priced drinks. Saturday specials include $1 tacos. The venue is known for its eclectic decor and welcoming atmosphere for both performers and audiences.

title: Blues Jam @ BB's Lawnside BBQ
event_description: Saturday afternoon blues jam led by Mama Ray featuring some of the best blues musicians in Kansas City. One of KCs greatest and longest running jam traditions.
event_venue_information:
About BB's Lawnside BBQ

BBs Lawnside BBQ has been the place where BBQ meets the Blues for over 30 years. The venue features an over 60-year-old granite stone pit that slow-smokes award-winning Kansas City-style barbecue while live blues fills the space.

Historic BBQ and Blues Tradition

The tradition of barbecue and blues in Kansas City started in the 1930s when Count Basie Joe Turner and Charlie Parker hung out at the Old Kentucky Bar-B-Q near 18th and Vine. BBs continues this legacy with granite stones from downtown crosswalks that perhaps Joe Turner once walked across.

Live Music Schedule

Live blues Wednesday through Sunday. Mama Rays blues jam every Saturday 2-6 PM is legendary. Wednesday features Jaisson Taylor and Brandon Hudspeth. Various blues acts Thursday through Sunday evenings. Monthly Kansas City Blues Society jam sessions.

Food and Atmosphere

Award-winning KCBS pit master Mike Nickle oversees slow-smoked meats including ribs brisket and pulled pork plus Louisiana favorites like gumbo jambalaya and boudin balls. Featured on Diners Drive-Ins and Dives.

About The Rino

The Rino is a music venue and event space located in the River North District of Kansas City. The name Rino is short for River North reflecting the venues location in one of KCs coolest up-and-coming neighborhoods north of the river.

Open Mic Programming

Free Monday Song Lab music open mic from 7-10 PM. All skill levels and genres welcome. The venue is passionate about supporting local music and touring artists with 100% of cover charges going to performers.

Venue Space

200-person capacity venue with excellent acoustics stage and A/V equipment. The Rino operates as a free co-working space during the day opening at 7 AM. Full bar service available during events.

Location and Accessibility

Located in the vibrant River North district just a short bridge from City Market. The neighborhood is growing rapidly with new restaurants cafes and cultural spaces. Free co-working space available alongside Cultivar coffee next door.

event_venue_information:
About Blue Ridge Boulevard UMC

Blue Ridge Boulevard United Methodist Church serves as the home for the Kansas City Area Bluegrass Music Club monthly gatherings from October through May. The church provides a welcoming space for acoustic music enthusiasts.

Event Format

Doors open at 6 PM with stage shows starting at 7 PM. Features both organized performances and open jamming opportunities for attendees. Donations collected to support the event. Enter through the back door from the parking lot.

Kansas City Area Bluegrass Music Club

Active bluegrass organization hosting monthly first Friday sessions throughout the season. Contact Al Hellebuyck at (816) 536-6764 or visit KCABMC.org. Also find the group on Facebook for updates and information.

Bluegrass Community

Kansas City has a rich bluegrass tradition with multiple jam sessions festivals and organizations throughout the metro area. The region hosts the annual Walnut Valley Festival in nearby Winfield Kansas and Lovegrass Music Festival.
